## Testing
- [ ] Backend unit/integration tests added or updated (`pytest`)

## Checklist
- [ ] CI green (lint, typecheck, tests + coverage gates, build, e2e)
- [ ] No secrets committed; `.env.example` updated if config changed
- [ ] Mobile-first: usable at 360px, touch targets >= 44px
- [ ] Real-time impact considered: no heavy work in the session play loop
